posts.cooked: sir when i login to oppe vm , it shows connection to this is closed and not able to login and when i login to course vm it shows host key verification failed .

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If you are

  • getting permission denied → please upload your public key to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in and try again, it should come back to same page. If it says error creating user, just resubmit the key again.
  • If you are getting PTY allocation request failed it means your public key is working, you are all set for OPPE. You cannot access the VM though till OPPE starts.
  • Getting host identity changed, run ssh-keygen -R sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in and then retry.

please check this
